- Risk: accidental removal/alteration of the Serena placeholder could break prompt rendering behavior.
- Risk: section heading/order drift would violate acceptance criteria and downstream expectations.
- Risk: dropping “insufficient data” handling guidance may weaken behavior when telemetry is sparse.
- Risk: adding guidance inconsistent with current operational constraints (e.g., suggesting external infra) would conflict with repo rules.

6. Testing considerations
- Run targeted analysis script invocation using existing input fixture/data to ensure prompt loads and report generation succeeds.
- Validate output includes all required headings in exact order.
- Verify prompt still yields concrete, evidence-oriented recommendations for speed, cost, reliability, GH API efficiency, MCP/Serena efficiency, cache/memory effectiveness, orchestrator health, and bottlenecks.
- Confirm no non-prompt files changed.
